descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S14 Offline mid-dictation and at the moment of an AI step, then back online, in both contexts: message, text kept, nothing spinning forever, saved after reconnect

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Offline / no network: a clear "no network" message; the dictation is kept and retried when the connection returns (OAT-03). (UAT EFS state 9; TFA-94745 state 9; TFA-92568 Eng 4)
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state. (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 3)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Standard fixture, chart open on the Encounter tab

When Type line one and wait for it to save; the harness takes the browser offline; type line two; tap Generate Note & Finish; open Ask AI and ask; type a pre-round line and tap Save Note; the harness brings the network back; tap Save Note once more (the message's next step); …

Then While offline a clear no-network message shows, it says the work saves when the connection returns, and every typed text stays on screen; each AI step tapped offline settles on a message within 20 s instead of spinning; after reconnect the message goes and after reload the typed text is on the server. No note is generated twice

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U9/U13 and the state 9 row literally: offline checkpoints mustContain 'no network', the typed text and a next-step phrase about the connection returning; each AI step tapped offline (Generate, Ask, Save Note) mustContain its text and a message 20 s after the tap and mustNotContain its busy label ('Generating Note', 'Searching', 'Saving & Updating'); …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
